'''Korpil''' was one of the largest and oldest colonies of the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Along with [[Slayn]], they created the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
